name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.mem_hodgeFil_of_hodge_basis
summary: Choose a Hodge basis: L is potentially crystalline; with A = P·diag(t^{κ_m}) (a unit), functionals ν_m of types κ_m have as basis values the rows of A⁻¹; μ = Σ_m D_m(μ)ν_m on fracSpan with D_m(μ) = (basisValues(μ)·A)_m (the reconstruction multiplies by A⁻¹: (basisValues(μ)·A)·A⁻¹ = basisValues(μ)), D_m equivariant and shifting by κ_m, and H applies to each term.

steps.claim: From the potential crystallinity of L (exists_hodge_basis for a finite basis of L): weights κ_m, a matrix P and the equivariance G of the Hodge–Tate comparison.
Let A = P·diag(t^{κ_m}) (entries in B_dR), a unit (an invertible matrix).
Choose A_inf-linear functionals ν_m on W(C^♭)⊗L with prescribed values on the basis: row m of A⁻¹ (A.2, the inverse of the unit A) (exists_functional_extend).
steps.lean: choose ν e using (exists_functional_extend <| (finBasis ..).constr ℕ <| A.2 ·)

steps.claim: basisValues(ν_m) = (A⁻¹)_m, row m of the inverse matrix.
steps.lean: have hν m : basisValues (ν m) = A.2 m := funext (by simp [basisValues, e])

steps.claim: On fracSpan, μ = Σ_m D_m(μ)·ν_m with D_m(μ) = (basisValues(μ)·A)_m (apply_eq_of_mem_fracSpan: both sides have the same basis values, Σ_m (basisValues(μ)·A)_m·(A⁻¹)_m = basisValues(μ)·A·A⁻¹ = basisValues(μ); rows of A in both places would reconstruct with A²); so μ(x) is a sum of terms D_m(μ)·ν_m(x), each in hodgeFil(n) by H with κ = κ_m, ν = ν_m, D = D_m:
steps.lean:
simpa [apply_eq_of_mem_fracSpan μ (∑ m, (basisValues μ ᵥ* A) m • ν m) (by simp [hν,
    ← vecMul_eq_sum]) hx] using sum_mem fun m _ ↦ H (κ m) _ ⟨forall_comm.1 fun g ↦
    (equivariant_iff_basisValues A.isUnit (G g)).2 (by simp [funext_iff, hν,
    ← mul_apply_eq_vecMul]), fun t ↦ mem_span.1 (ainfLattice_eq_span_basis.le
    (letterProj_mk_mem_ainfLattice t)) (comap _ ((hodgeFil ..).restrictScalars
    _)) (by simp [e, A, mem_hodgeFil, mul_comm])⟩ (.proj m ∘ₗ vecMulLinear A ∘ₗ
    basisValues) (fun _ _ h ↦ sum_mem fun l _ ↦ mul_mem_hodgeFil (h _) (mem_hodgeFil.2 ⟨P.1 l m, by
    simp [A]⟩)) fun _ _ g h ↦ congrFun ((equivariant_iff_basisValues A.isUnit (G g)).1 h) m

steps.claim: ν_m ∈ formsOfType(L, i, κ_m): it is Γ'-equivariant (equivariant_iff_basisValues with G), and it maps letterProj(L, i)(1 ⊗ t), which lies in the span of the basis vectors, into t^{−κ_m}B_dR^+.
steps.lean:
⟨forall_comm.1 fun g ↦
    (equivariant_iff_basisValues A.isUnit (G g)).2 (by simp [funext_iff, hν,
    ← mul_apply_eq_vecMul]), fun t ↦ mem_span.1 (ainfLattice_eq_span_basis.le
    (letterProj_mk_mem_ainfLattice t)) (comap _ ((hodgeFil ..).restrictScalars
    _)) (by simp [e, A, mem_hodgeFil, mul_comm])⟩

steps.claim: D_m shifts by κ_m: if all μ'(1 ⊗ t) lie in hodgeFil(m'), then D_m(μ') = Σ_l μ'(b_l)P_{lm}t^{κ_m} ∈ hodgeFil(m' + κ_m).
steps.lean:
(fun _ _ h ↦ sum_mem fun l _ ↦ mul_mem_hodgeFil (h _) (mem_hodgeFil.2 ⟨P.1 l m, by
    simp [A]⟩))
fun _ _ g h ↦ congrFun ((equivariant_iff_basisValues A.isUnit (G g)).1 h) m
